responsibility: Defines the stable type-level interface and introspection model for trait solving in `rustc_type_ir`: it specifies the canonical goals, query inputs and responses, certainty and candidate-source classifications, reveal modes, and constraint payloads that describe solver interaction, while also providing the inspection and proof-tree structures that record per-goal evaluation, probes, candidate exploration, and observed results for diagnostics and other solver introspection. Together, these files define both the semantic API surface of solver queries and the structured record of how those queries were explored.
